Heavy Rains Cause Disruption and Disasters Across India

Several regions in India are experiencing severe disruptions due to heavy monsoon rains. Incidents include landslides, building collapses, and flash floods, leading to casualties and trapping individuals. Waterlogging has affected urban areas like Mumbai and Pune, while rural Maharashtra faces water scarcity issues, with over 1,200 villages relying on tankers. Some states are also conserving water resources due to poor monsoon performance.
